Punch Card Engineer

London, United Kingdom

Brass Gear Systems builds calculating machines for people who would rather not do sums by hand. You will design the cards that tell our engines what to do, test them on real brass, and write notes clear enough for the next engineer to follow.

This posting is a test fixture. The company, the job and every person on this page are made up.
